agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Vancouver 2027 by-law sets interest rate on overdue property taxes
agenda_briefs.summary: Council will vote on a by-law setting the 2027 interest rate on delinquent (overdue) property taxes at 8.45% per annum, compounded annually. If approved, this rate applies to all real property taxes that become delinquent after December 31, 2026. Property owners who pay late in 2027 will owe this interest on top of the unpaid taxes.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for the council vote on September 10, 2026, and prepare for the 8.45% annual interest rate on any 2027 property taxes paid late.
